extraction.notes: No official camp website or readable official program page could be located. A third-party AllEvents listing names Hominy Valley Splash n’ Scholars Summer Camp on June 22, 2026 at 475 Enka Lake Road, Candler. A FindGlocal search snippet reproduces a July 24, 2026 post saying its first summer ended that day. Neither page could be read beyond search snippets, and no official source verified the schedule, activities, ages, prices or registration. No 2027 information was found. Cards are left empty rather than publishing an unverified offering. Reviewer should obtain the provider's official page or registration materials.
